meaning: variant field/source/population QA, not model evaluation or original-question certification

variant_source_qa.reference_query: MATCH (m:Meeting {meetingNumber:'RAN1#120'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode:'NR_eMIMO-Core'}) RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
MATCH (m:Meeting {meetingNumber:'RAN1#120'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Huawei'}) RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Huawei'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,a.resolutionId AS resolutionId,m.meetingNumber AS meetingNumber
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem), (t)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Huawei'}) WHERE t.summaryType='FL' RETURN DISTINCT ai.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber

MATCH (a:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(a) WHERE a.sectionId<b.sectionId MATCH (a)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp1:Spec) MATCH (b)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT a.sectionId AS sectionIdA,b.sectionId AS sectionIdB,sp1.specNumber+'-'+a.sectionNumber AS sectionA,sp2.specNumber+'-'+b.sectionNumber AS sectionB ORDER BY sectionIdA,sectionIdB LIMIT 20
MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*antenna.*' RETURN DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WITH cr,count(DISTINCT sp) AS affectedSpecCount,collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS specs UNWIND specs AS specNumber WITH cr,affectedSpecCount,specNumber ORDER BY specNumber WITH cr,affectedSpecCount,collect(specNumber) AS affectedSpecs RETURN cr.tdocNumber AS crNumber,affectedSpecCount,affectedSpecs ORDER BY affectedSpecCount DESC,crNumber ASC LIMIT 10
